claims.claim_text: The indexed Alceste G Cornaro is a high-confidence match to the sole exact-name Army row and the Alceste G. Cornaro obituary.
claims.evidence_excerpt: He was born in Marlboro, MA on May 1, 1918.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The rare exact name, matching 1918 birth-year evidence, Massachusetts origin, compatible January 1942 Army entry, radio-intelligence chronology and 1945 discharge support one person.
claims.identity_match_assessment: The uncommon exact full name plus aligned birth year, state and wartime chronology provide multiple discriminators beyond the name. No index identifier or direct Box 144 link was available, so the status remains high confidence rather than confirmed.
claims.temporal_assessment: The sources date Army entry and prewar CCC work but do not establish the exact OSS-entry date or Army-to-OSS sequence.
claims.match_notes: Radio-intelligence service corroborates wartime context but is not treated as proof of an immediate pre-OSS assignment.
